Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. Suppliers should have 5 years of experience in BD market.
2. Supplier shall provide at least 2 Satisfactory Completion Certificate of Supplying IT and related equipment in the
government/semi government organization in the last two (02) years.
3. The Supplier must submit NOA and Experience certificate of honoring a single tender of min Taka 15 Lac on of Supplying IT and
related equipment in the last two (02) years in the government/semi government organization with e-GP Tender ID.
4. The Supplier should have the Bank solvency Certificate. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit
facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 15 Lac.
5. Up-to-date Trade License, Valid TIN Certificate, Tax clearance certificate of the financial year 2021-22 (with payment slip) and
VAT Registration/ BIN certificate.
6. Tenderer shall furnish the average annual turnover at least 15 lacs (sum of 45 Lac for three years) over the best three (03) years
in last 5(five) years.
7. Valid documents having office / Sub office in Chittagong for instant support and service.
